journeys.review: Read against the device log: after the film ended at 19999 ms the player left on its own and the demo page remounted with Play focused (04:40:22Z); the driver's first Back then went to Harbor's Details with focus on Try picture holds (04:40:25Z) and its second to Home with focus on Details (04:40:31Z). The driver had expected one more Back to leave the player, so it reported partial; every state it listed is the designed one. The same self-return ended the ordinary Harbor journey (J4) onto Home with focus on Play.

touch_note: A first attempt at this session, minutes earlier, saw a touch injected on the device five seconds after the cold launch, at the Details control; the driver sends only remote keys, so the touch came from outside it (the simulator window on the Mac). That attempt was discarded and this run records any touch count seen.
